subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Should the macOS approval dialog show only the existing session key, or also show a redacted channel/requester identity derived from turn-source metadata?
rationale: The session key already supports disambiguation, but channel, sender, account, and thread fields may expose private context in a security-sensitive approval surface; the repository needs a deliberate disclosure contract before adding them.

options.title: Ship session key only
options.body: Render a trimmed non-empty Session row now and keep requester metadata out of the native dialog until an explicit disclosure design exists.

options.title: Define redacted requester context
options.body: Specify approved channel, sender, account, and thread fields plus redaction rules, then extend the native payload and dialog together.

options.title: Keep current dialog
options.body: Retain the existing command-focused prompt and direct operators to other surfaces for context.

recommendation.title: Ship session key only
recommendation.body: Render a trimmed non-empty Session row now and keep requester metadata out of the native dialog until an explicit disclosure design exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review already identified the unresolved disclosure contract and kept the issue open for maintainer follow-up.
